sentences.text: Misc. Criminal Case No. 39396 of 2024

Dharmendra
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others

Appearance:
 Shri Amit Jain - Advocate for applicant.
Ms.C.K.Pal - Pl for respondent/State.
ORDER Heard on this first bail application filed by applicant- Dharmendra under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita for grant of bail.

2. The applicant is in jail since 13.07.2024 in connection with Crime No.213 of 2024, registered at Police Station- Khimlasa, District- Sagar for the offence under Sections 363, 366A and 376(2)(n) of IPC and 5L/6 of POCSO Act.

3 . As per the case of the prosecution, allegations against the present applicant are that he took away minor prosecutrix and thereafter committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault repeatedly on minor prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that it is a case of consent.
Prsoecutrix is aged more than 17 years 6 months.
Prosecutrix as well as applicant want to marry.
Applicant is in jail since 13.07.2024.
No injury has been found on the person of prosecutrix in her medical examination.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.

sentences.text: 6. Having regard to facts and circumstances of the case, including nature of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:46194 2 MCRC-39396-2024 evidence and role of applicant, I deem it proper to release the applicants on bail.
Consequently, bail application filed on behalf of applicants, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant - Dharmendra be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
9. Certified copy as per rules.
